name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-08-08, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 3.54 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
